subject: Proposed temporary subprocessor EdgeRelay — escrow & export path verification
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@finbridge.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego@edge-relay.io>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary subprocessor (EdgeRelay) for pilot telemetry

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the walkthrough of Redwood Dedicated last week — the pilot is shaping up well. Our security team is asking for one more piece before we sign off: EdgeRelay (the telemetry relay vendor) will be attached to our pilot for a 6-week window to collect anonymized routing metrics. They are a temporary processor for this scope.

Could you please provide:
- A short manifest of the processing role for EdgeRelay (purpose, data types, retention)
- Confirmation of the export path(s) and whether any data will transit outside the EU/US during the pilot
- Any escrow/temporary-access controls you plan to rely on

Diego from EdgeRelay is on-copy and can provide technical details. Our legal lead would like to review the manifest by EOD Monday if possible.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Infrastructure — FinBridge
Samantha Ortiz

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@finbridge.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego@edge-relay.io>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary subprocessor (EdgeRelay) for pilot telemetry

Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kimberly (privacy) and Marcus (runtime/ops) to validate the manifest and export path.

Quick summary of our plan:
- EdgeRelay will act as a transient telemetry relay for the pilot only (no user content, only anonymized latency/route metrics and stamped telemetry).
- Retention: EdgeRelay will hold telemetry for a rolling 14 days and then push aggregates to FinBridge. We will enforce minimum-privilege processing in the DPA addendum.
- Export paths: primary flow is US -> EdgeRelay EU relay -> Final aggregation in FinBridge EU region. Marcus to confirm there are no outbound hops to third regions.
- Escrow/controls: we will require EdgeRelay to upload a signed manifest and attest to no-persistence of raw pseudonymized IDs; we can also require time-limited SSH keys and an audit snapshot if FinBridge wants proof.

Kimberly / Marcus — can you review the attached manifest from EdgeRelay and the export-path diagram Diego sent and confirm whether this satisfies FinBridge's ask or whether they need the DPA addendum redlined? Samantha — if Kimberly requests a redline, we can fast-track a short DPA addendum for temporary processors.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Lead — Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Samantha Ortiz <samantha@finbridge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Diego Ramos <diego@edge-relay.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary subprocessor (EdgeRelay) for pilot telemetry

Samantha / team — thanks for the manifest, Diego. I did a first pass. High-level notes:

1) Scope & data types: wording is good — confirm explicitly that no PII or full request bodies will be logged. "Anonymized routing telemetry" should be defined as non-linkable to user identifiers.

2) Retention and deletion: 14-day rolling retention is acceptable for pilot if we get a deletion proof (snapshot + log of purge action) at the end of the window.

3) Export paths: the diagram shows an EU relay and a US control plane. Marcus, please confirm whether any fallback or CDN hop could route data to APAC during outages. We need to assert the list of jurisdictions the telemetry may transit.

4) Controls / escrow: we typically ask for:
- Signed manifest from EdgeRelay (versioned PDF)
- Time-limited credentials for any remote access and access logs
- A short annex to the DPA covering temporary processors (one page) that we can attach as a signed addendum; this covers retention, deletion proof, and limited liability for the pilot.

Samantha — if FinBridge can accept the DPA addendum model we use for temporary processors, that will speed legal review. Otherwise we can accept a short redline and triage but will need a 24–48 hour review window.

Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy Counsel — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Samantha Ortiz <samantha@finbridge.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego@edge-relay.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary subprocessor (EdgeRelay) for pilot telemetry

Quick infra check from my side after reviewing Diego's diagram (attached):

- Primary path: FinBridge EU -> our EU ingress -> EdgeRelay EU relay -> FinBridge EU aggregation. No APAC hops in normal operation.
- Fallbacks: there is a short-lived fallback route to a US control plane for heartbeat-only packets; we can disable that for the pilot window if FinBridge requires strict EU-only transit.
- Auditability: EdgeRelay supports time-limited SSH and will provide access logs and an ASN hop list. For deletion proof, we can capture a sha256 digest of the purge run and share the purge log signed by EdgeRelay.

Action items (to close this thread):
- Diego: please upload the signed manifest PDF and the export-path-diagram.png to the shared Doc (link above) and confirm that EdgeRelay will provide the purge log at the end of the 6-week window.
- Kimberly: if you can confirm the DPA addendum template works, I will coordinate ops to disable the US control-plane fallback for the pilot.
- Lauren: let Samantha know the timeline to FinBridge legal once we have the manifest and your confirmation.

Thanks
Marcus Lin
Senior Runtime Engineer — Redwood Inference
